hero.alt: Athanasius Kircher's 1652 engraving of a Kabbalistic Tree of Life
hero.caption: Athanasius Kircher's 1652 Tree of Life is a powerful example of later Christian and Hermetic reception. It should not be mistaken for the visual form of ancient Jewish mysticism.

ezekiel.alt: 1538 woodcut depicting Ezekiel's divine throne vision and wheels within wheels
ezekiel.caption: Ezekiel's throne vision became a major source for later Jewish and Christian esoteric interpretation.
